rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: What's wrong, Gainer? You came back in such a hurry -- did the errand go well?
rows.display_text:
「What's wrong, Gainer? You came back in
such a hurry -- did the errand go well?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What a waste. All that makeup, and you went and washed it off.
rows.display_text:
「What a waste. All that makeup, and you
went and washed it off.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: This isn't the time for that! Watch out!
rows.display_text:
「This isn't the time for that! Watch
out!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: It's just a bunch of kids. Let's scatter them and be done with it!
rows.display_text:
「It's just a bunch of kids. Let's
scatter them and be done with it!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: While we're at it, let's grab what we can from this town and skip out!
rows.display_text:
「While we're at it, let's grab what we
can from this town and skip out!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: What's with those guys!? They look raring to go!
rows.display_text:
「What's with those guys!? They look
raring to go!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I'm not sure, but it sounds like they're wanted criminals.
rows.display_text:
「I'm not sure, but it sounds like they're
wanted criminals.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: We can't let people like that do as they please with Katez's dome!
rows.display_text:
「We can't let people like that do as
they please with Katez's dome!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I know...! Let's protect the dome ourselves!
rows.display_text:
「I know...! Let's protect the dome
ourselves!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton... let me pilot. Switch seats with me.
rows.display_text:
「Renton... let me pilot. Switch seats
with me.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: No...

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton...
rows.display_text: 「Renton...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'm the one who got asked to run this errand. And now it's turned into this...
rows.display_text:
「I'm the one who got asked to run this
errand. And now it's turned into this...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: So I... I want to settle this myself, with my own strength...! I have to!
rows.display_text:
「So I... I want to settle this myself,
with my own strength...! I have to!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: ...Okay.
rows.display_text: 「...Okay.」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: But... that outfit looks a little weird.
rows.display_text: 「But... that outfit looks a little weird.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I-it does!?
rows.display_text: 「I-it does!?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: They've got the numbers on us. This could get ugly.
rows.display_text:
「They've got the numbers on us. This
could get ugly.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: It's fine. The Gekko-Goh will be here soon.
rows.display_text:
「It's fine. The Gekko-Goh will be here
soon.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: You already called for backup?
rows.display_text: 「You already called for backup?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Something like that.
rows.display_text: 「Something like that.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Here I come, you thugs! I'm a member of Gekkostate too!
rows.display_text:
「Here I come, you thugs! I'm a member
of Gekkostate too!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'm not about to go down here before I finish my mission!
rows.display_text:
「I'm not about to go down here before I
finish my mission!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: That guy... he's serious...
rows.display_text: 「That guy... he's serious...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Pulling in a gang of thugs on his very first errand...
rows.display_text:
（Pulling in a gang of thugs on his very
first errand...）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Man... That kid's a trouble magnet if I ever saw one...
rows.display_text:
（Man... That kid's a trouble magnet if I
ever saw one...）

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: They really did come right away!
rows.display_text: 「They really did come right away!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Whoa...! It's like they knew we were in trouble!
rows.display_text:
「Whoa...! It's like they knew we were in
trouble!」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Well, of course we did...
rows.display_text: （Well, of course we did...）

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: We've been monitoring Renton and the others' every move, after all.
rows.display_text:
（We've been monitoring Renton and the
others' every move, after all.）

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: What is the meaning of this? Why were Renton and the others in this town?
rows.display_text:
「What is the meaning of this? Why were
Renton and the others in this town?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: W-who knows... They were probably just bored and came out shopping or something.
rows.display_text:
「W-who knows... They were probably just
bored and came out shopping or something.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Don't worry, Renton! Now that we're here, you're in the clear!
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry, Renton! Now that we're
here, you're in the clear!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Thank you, everyone!
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, everyone!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Let's wrap this up quick before Ken-Goh catches on we've been hazing the rookie.
rows.display_text:
（Let's wrap this up quick before
Ken-Goh catches on we've been hazing the
rookie.）

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Roger that...! Lucky for us, Renton hasn't caught on to the prank this time either.
rows.display_text:
（Roger that...! Lucky for us, Renton
hasn't caught on to the prank this time
either.）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Let's move, everyone! Show them our Lifting is unbeatable, snow or no snow!
rows.display_text:
「Let's move, everyone! Show them our
Lifting is unbeatable, snow or no snow!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Man, Holland's just too cool...!
rows.display_text: （Man, Holland's just too cool...!）

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Confirmed: all enemies destroyed.
rows.display_text: 「Confirmed: all enemies destroyed.」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Those guys are supposedly wanted criminals. If we hand them over to the Federation, that's a bounty in our pocket.
rows.display_text:
「Those guys are supposedly wanted
criminals. If we hand them over to the
Federation, that's a bounty in our pocket.」

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: What are you talking about. We're wanted criminals too.
rows.display_text:
「What are you talking about. We're
wanted criminals too.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Um, Hap... about the package...
rows.display_text: 「Um, Hap... about the package...」

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: Package?
rows.display_text: 「Package?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Ah, right...! You mean the boots I asked you to pick up? Never mind about those!
rows.display_text:
「Ah, right...! You mean the boots I
asked you to pick up? Never mind about
those!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That's... Renton was doing his best to complete the errand he was given!
rows.display_text:
「That's... Renton was doing his best to
complete the errand he was given!」

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: Errand...?
rows.display_text: 「Errand...?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: We delivered something dangerous enough to blow up a whole town, packed inside a delivery box, all the way to Katez exactly as we were told...
rows.display_text:
「We delivered something dangerous enough
to level a town, packed in a box, to
Katez exactly as ordered...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: What an on-the-nose line that was!
rows.display_text: 「What an on-the-nose line that was!」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: G-Gainer! Let's save that story for after we get back, shall we!
rows.display_text:
「G-Gainer! Let's save that story for
after we get back, shall we!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Why's that? We're still in the middle of our errand!
rows.display_text:
「Why's that? We're still in the middle of
our errand!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: That's just it, it's already...
rows.display_text: 「That's just it, it's already...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: We've come this far, so we're going to see it through to the end!
rows.display_text:
「We've come this far, so we're going to
see it through to the end!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: We had a rough time -- getting hassled by thugs, dragged into fights, all of it!
rows.display_text:
「We had a rough time -- getting hassled
by thugs, dragged into fights, all of it!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: We did all of it because you told us to, Hap. Telling us to stop halfway now doesn't make sense!
rows.display_text:
「We did all of it because you told us
to, Hap. Telling us to stop halfway now
doesn't make sense!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: So what exactly was that dangerous something put in the delivery box? Tell us!
rows.display_text:
「So what exactly was that dangerous
something put in the delivery box? Tell
us!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Ah... uh...

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: That's enough, Gainer Sanga. It seems my people have caused you trouble.
rows.display_text:
「That's enough, Gainer Sanga. It seems
my people have caused you trouble.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Huh!? What's going on here!?
rows.display_text: 「Huh!? What's going on here!?」

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: I'll make a proper apology to you and Garrod later.
rows.display_text:
「I'll make a proper apology to you and
Garrod later.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: You lot! You've been hazing the rookie again, haven't you! I told you to knock off that nonsense!
rows.display_text:
「You lot! You've been hazing the rookie
again, haven't you! I told you to knock
off that nonsense!」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: T-that's, well... it's a kind of expression of affection, really...
rows.display_text:
「T-that's, well... it's a kind of
expression of affection, really...」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Honestly, you two... if that's affection, I'd answer it with a punch.
rows.display_text:
「Honestly, you two... if that's affection,
I'd answer it with a punch.」

rows.speaker: Ken-Goh
rows.en: You're getting a lecture when we're back. Consider it tough love, from me.
rows.display_text:
「You're getting a lecture when we're
back. Consider it tough love, from me.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: ...Yes, sir.
rows.display_text: 「...Yes, sir.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...Was I... just being messed with... this whole time...?
rows.display_text:
「...Was I... just being messed with... this
whole time...?」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Damn it! Looks like Tiffa's hunch was right after all!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! Looks like Tiffa's hunch was
right after all!」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Garrod...
rows.display_text: 「Garrod...」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Don't worry, Tiffa! Whatever bad thing was coming, it ends here!
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry, Tiffa! Whatever bad thing
was coming, it ends here!」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: As long as I'm around, I'll protect you no matter what! So just hang in there a little longer!
rows.display_text:
「As long as I'm around, I'll protect you
no matter what! So just hang in there a
little longer!」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: Okay...
rows.display_text: 「Okay...」

rows.speaker: Tiffa
rows.en: I believe in you, Garrod.
rows.display_text: （I believe in you, Garrod.）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: This errand... it's way too unnatural.
rows.display_text: （This errand... it's way too unnatural.）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: If my hunch is right, then this is...
rows.display_text: （If my hunch is right, then this is...）

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: I knew leaving it to just Gainer and Garrod would be worrying, and sure enough, trouble found them...!
rows.display_text:
「I knew leaving it to just Gainer and
Garrod would be worrying, and sure
enough, trouble found them...!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: We're the ones who protected this town of Katez from the Moonrace...!
rows.display_text:
「We're the ones who protected this town
of Katez from the Moonrace...!」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: We won't let a bunch of thugs do as they please!
rows.display_text:
「We won't let a bunch of thugs do as
they please!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Renton...!
rows.display_text: 「Renton...!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: It's fine...! I'm not scared, not even a little!
rows.display_text:
「It's fine...! I'm not scared, not even a
little!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Because I've got Eureka and Nirvash with me!
rows.display_text:
「Because I've got Eureka and Nirvash
with me!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Y-yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Let's go, Nirvash! I'll give it everything I've got, so lend me your strength!!
rows.display_text:
「Let's go, Nirvash! I'll give it everything
I've got, so lend me your strength!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Yes! This is Renton! Go ahead with your instructions!
rows.display_text:
「Yes! This is Renton! Go ahead with your
instructions!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Pfft... what's with that getup!?
rows.display_text: （Pfft... what's with that getup!?）

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: So that's Gekkostate's prized urban camouflage, huh.
rows.display_text:
（So that's Gekkostate's prized urban
camouflage, huh.）

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: However you look at it, that's just a tracksuit!
rows.display_text:
（However you look at it, that's just a
tracksuit!）

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Don't say it so loud, Witz. You'll ruin the whole setup.
rows.display_text:
（Don't say it so loud, Witz. You'll ruin
the whole setup.）

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: All right... looks like they've arrived at Katez, for now.
rows.display_text:
「All right... looks like they've arrived at
Katez, for now.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Thanks to Gainer and Garrod too, for lending a hand.
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to Gainer and Garrod too, for
lending a hand.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Don't worry about it. We're all members of the same $c.
rows.display_text:
「Don't worry about it. We're all members
of the same $c.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Yeah, exactly. Companions on the road, and all that.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, exactly. Companions on the road,
and all that.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Tch... calling in backup, what a small-time move from Renton.
rows.display_text:
（Tch... calling in backup, what a
small-time move from Renton.）

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Don't say that. Friendship's a nice thing, isn't it?
rows.display_text:
（Don't say that. Friendship's a nice
thing, isn't it?）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: So... what should we do from here?
rows.display_text: 「So... what should we do from here?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: First, get out of your machine and infiltrate Katez on foot.
rows.display_text:
「First, get out of your machine and
infiltrate Katez on foot.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: This is a top-secret operation, though. Keep the infiltration team to the bare minimum; the rest stand by in the area.
rows.display_text:
「This is a top-secret operation, though.
Keep the infiltration team to the bare
minimum; the rest stand by in the area.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Then... I'll go alone.
rows.display_text: 「Then... I'll go alone.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Wait... You're going in with one other person.
rows.display_text:
「Wait... You're going in with one other
person.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Actually, a troublesome problem's come up.
rows.display_text:
「Actually, a troublesome problem's come
up.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: I told the delivery contact about you already, but it seems they're being cautious.
rows.display_text:
「I told the delivery contact about you
already, but it seems they're being
cautious.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: It looks like they're even suspicious of us, the couriers.
rows.display_text:
「It looks like they're even suspicious of
us, the couriers.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: No way!
rows.display_text: 「No way!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: They've told us to send a girl along with you as an extra courier.
rows.display_text:
「They've told us to send a girl along
with you as an extra courier.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: They're probably planning to use her as an insurance hostage.
rows.display_text:
「They're probably planning to use her as
an insurance hostage.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: H-hostage...?
rows.display_text: 「H-hostage...?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: As luck would have it -- good or bad -- you've got Eureka, Sara, and Tiffa with you. Ask one of them to come along.
rows.display_text:
「As luck would have it -- good or bad
-- you've got Eureka, Sara, and Tiffa
with you. Ask one of them to come along.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Asking someone to do something that dangerous!?
rows.display_text:
「Asking someone to do something that
dangerous!?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: There's a risk of eavesdropping. That's all for my first set of instructions.
rows.display_text:
「There's a risk of eavesdropping. That's
all for my first set of instructions.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Once you've infiltrated Katez with your partner, contact us. That's all.
rows.display_text:
「Once you've infiltrated Katez with your
partner, contact us. That's all.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: W-wait, Hap! Hap!!
rows.display_text: 「W-wait, Hap! Hap!!」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: That's a great reaction out of him!
rows.display_text: 「That's a great reaction out of him!」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: Seriously! That outfit... it's basically a joke at this point!
rows.display_text:
「Seriously! That outfit... it's basically a
joke at this point!」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Now, now. The kid's dead serious about it.
rows.display_text:
「Now, now. The kid's dead serious about
it.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Is this some kind of newcomer welcome ritual for Gekkostate?
rows.display_text:
「Is this some kind of newcomer welcome
ritual for Gekkostate?」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Well, something like that.
rows.display_text: 「Well, something like that.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Hazing the rookie is a kind of affection, you know.
rows.display_text:
「Hazing the rookie is a kind of
affection, you know.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: I've got no intention of butting into your ways, but from the receiving end, it can't be much fun.
rows.display_text:
「I've got no intention of butting into
your ways, but from the receiving end, it
can't be much fun.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Well... if he runs off over this, then that's all he ever was.
rows.display_text:
「Well... if he runs off over this, then
that's all he ever was.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: It's not like we bowed our heads and begged him to join us, after all.
rows.display_text:
「It's not like we bowed our heads and
begged him to join us, after all.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: By the way, what was that about a partner just now? I never heard anything about that bit.
rows.display_text:
「By the way, what was that about a
partner just now? I never heard anything
about that bit.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: As for that, since Renton called in backup, I just raised the bar a little.
rows.display_text:
「As for that, since Renton called in
backup, I just raised the bar a little.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: But then... isn't whoever gets picked as his partner going to have it rough?
rows.display_text:
「But then... isn't whoever gets picked as
his partner going to have it rough?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: So, here's a question. Who do you think they'll pick for the infiltration team?
rows.display_text:
「So, here's a question. Who do you think
they'll pick for the infiltration team?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Tiffa, Sara, or Eureka, huh... Isn't Tiffa the natural pick, what with that strange power of hers?
rows.display_text:
「Tiffa, Sara, or Eureka, huh... Isn't
Tiffa the natural pick, what with that
strange power of hers?」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: Garrod would never let Tiffa put herself in danger like that.
rows.display_text:
「Garrod would never let Tiffa put
herself in danger like that.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: I'd bet it's Eureka, since she's from Gekkostate too, same as Renton.
rows.display_text:
「I'd bet it's Eureka, since she's from
Gekkostate too, same as Renton.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: I wonder. Renton's right smack in the middle of puberty.
rows.display_text:
「I wonder. Renton's right smack in the
middle of puberty.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: I'd say he couldn't stand walking around with Eureka dressed like that.
rows.display_text:
「I'd say he couldn't stand walking around
with Eureka dressed like that.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: So by process of elimination, it's Sara?
rows.display_text: 「So by process of elimination, it's Sara?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: That girl's got guts to spare. I'd say the odds are pretty high.
rows.display_text:
「That girl's got guts to spare. I'd say
the odds are pretty high.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: But if Sara's the one going, young Gainer's not going to sit quiet about it.
rows.display_text:
「But if Sara's the one going, young
Gainer's not going to sit quiet about it.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: The kid's got enough resolve to declare he wants to hug her tight enough to crush her, after all.
rows.display_text:
「The kid's got enough resolve to declare
he wants to hug her tight enough to
crush her, after all.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Thinking time's over. Now then... each of the three has her own circumstances, but what's the answer, I wonder...?
rows.display_text:
「Thinking time's over. Now then... each
of the three has her own circumstances,
but what's the answer, I wonder...?」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: In the end, he might not be able to choose anyone and just give up before he even gets into the town.
rows.display_text:
「In the end, he might not be able to
choose anyone and just give up before he
even gets into the town.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: That part's a treat for later -- watch and see.
rows.display_text:
「That part's a treat for later -- watch
and see.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: Moondoggie's already in Katez. Renton thinks he can only reach us by voice, but...
rows.display_text:
「Moondoggie's already in Katez. Renton
thinks he can only reach us by voice,
but...」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: We can watch his every move perfectly, thanks to Doggy's camera.
rows.display_text:
「We can watch his every move perfectly,
thanks to Doggy's camera.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: And we're watching it and feeding him instructions on the fly.
rows.display_text:
「And we're watching it and feeding him
instructions on the fly.」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: That's tasteless beyond belief.
rows.display_text: 「That's tasteless beyond belief.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Watching along like this makes us just as guilty, I'd say.
rows.display_text:
「Watching along like this makes us just
as guilty, I'd say.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Everyone needs a little recreation now and then. Now... let's look forward to Renton's crew's next move.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone needs a little recreation now
and then. Now... let's look forward to
Renton's crew's next move.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Hap! We've got footage coming in from Doggy!
rows.display_text:
「Hap! We've got footage coming in from
Doggy!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: So that means Renton's already infiltrated Katez, huh.
rows.display_text:
「So that means Renton's already
infiltrated Katez, huh.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Sending the footage... to the monitor now.
rows.display_text:
「Sending the footage... to the monitor
now.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...This is Renton. Hap, please respond.
rows.display_text: 「...This is Renton. Hap, please respond.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: This is Hap. How's your partner holding up?
rows.display_text:
「This is Hap. How's your partner holding
up?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: A-actually, about that...
rows.display_text: 「A-actually, about that...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: N-no... never mind the report. I'll... I'll trust your painful decision.
rows.display_text:
「N-no... never mind the report. I'll... I'll
trust your painful decision.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Eureka, Tiffa, Sara... I won't ask which one you picked, but I want to salute your resolve.
rows.display_text:
「Eureka, Tiffa, Sara... I won't ask which
one you picked, but I want to salute your
resolve.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Hap... your voice sounds like it's shaking...
rows.display_text:
「Hap... your voice sounds like it's
shaking...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: ...Never mind about this end. Now, make contact with the recipient.
rows.display_text:
「...Never mind about this end. Now, make
contact with the recipient.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: According to the information we've got, the target is... a man in a yellow suit.
rows.display_text:
「According to the information we've got,
the target is... a man in a yellow suit.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Understood...! I'll do my best.
rows.display_text: 「Understood...! I'll do my best.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Good luck out there.
rows.display_text: 「Good luck out there.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I've come this far... All that's left is to steel myself and push on.
rows.display_text:
「I've come this far... All that's left is
to steel myself and push on.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Let's go, miss...!
rows.display_text: 「Let's go, miss...!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Y-yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah...」

rows.speaker: Witz
rows.en: Of all people, it's Gainer in drag!?
rows.display_text: 「Of all people, it's Gainer in drag!?」

rows.speaker: Toniya
rows.en: But you've got to admit, he thought it through! Taking the fall himself so his sweetheart wouldn't be put in danger!
rows.display_text:
「But you've got to admit, he thought it
through! Taking the fall himself so his
sweetheart wouldn't be put in danger!」

rows.speaker: Roybea
rows.en: ...Might be more his taste than we thought.
rows.display_text:
「...Might be more his taste than we
thought.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Whew... I'm impressed. Even I had a hard time holding back a laugh.
rows.display_text:
「Whew... I'm impressed. Even I had a hard
time holding back a laugh.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: But honestly, that was iffy! Actually, more like gross!
rows.display_text:
「But honestly, that was iffy! Actually,
more like gross!」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: No, no... the basic idea isn't bad. It's the makeup that's the problem there.
rows.display_text:
「No, no... the basic idea isn't bad. It's
the makeup that's the problem there.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Heh heh... when he gets back, maybe I'll do his makeup myself.
rows.display_text:
「Heh heh... when he gets back, maybe I'll
do his makeup myself.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: So, is the guy kicking that game table over there the one designated as the target?
rows.display_text:
「So, is the guy kicking that game table
over there the one designated as the
target?」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Is this going to be okay? He's got total thug written all over him.
rows.display_text:
「Is this going to be okay? He's got
total thug written all over him.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: He muscled through the first stage by sheer force. I'm sure he'll pull through the next one too.
rows.display_text:
「He muscled through the first stage by
sheer force. I'm sure he'll pull through
the next one too.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Oh... he's moving. Now then... let's see what he's got.
rows.display_text:
「Oh... he's moving. Now then... let's see
what he's got.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Um, excuse me...
rows.display_text: 「Um, excuse me...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: What is it? What's a kid want with me?
rows.display_text: 「What is it? What's a kid want with me?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Um... well...
rows.display_text: 「Um... well...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I'm in a rotten mood! Stuck around here until my mech's repairs are done...
rows.display_text:
「I'm in a rotten mood! Stuck around here
until my mech's repairs are done...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: If you've got business, spit it out already!!
rows.display_text:
「If you've got business, spit it out
already!!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: I... I mean, we've come as messengers from Gekkostate...
rows.display_text:
「I... I mean, we've come as messengers
from Gekkostate...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Gekkostate, huh? What's that rumored sky pirate crew want with me?
rows.display_text:
「Gekkostate, huh? What's that rumored
sky pirate crew want with me?」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Or is it, missy... you trying to pick me up?
rows.display_text:
「Or is it, missy... you trying to pick me
up?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Eh... uh... well...
rows.display_text: 「Eh... uh... well...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Well... you're not my type, but there're all sorts of tastes out there.
rows.display_text:
「Well... you're not my type, but there're
all sorts of tastes out there.」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: I could snatch you up and drag you off to some rich old man, too.
rows.display_text:
「I could snatch you up and drag you off
to some rich old man, too.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Eek...! D-don't touch me!
rows.display_text: 「Eek...! D-don't touch me!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: S-sorry, mister! W-wrong person!!
rows.display_text: 「S-sorry, mister! W-wrong person!!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: You little punk! Who're you calling 'mister'!!
rows.display_text:
「You little punk! Who're you calling
'mister'!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'm sooorryyyy!!
rows.display_text: 「I'm sooorryyyy!!」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: What was that all about...
rows.display_text: 「What was that all about...」

rows.speaker: Beck
rows.en: Achoo! Damn it! Why's it gotta be this cold in Siberia!
rows.display_text:
「Achoo! Damn it! Why's it gotta be this
cold in Siberia!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: H-Hap... that guy didn't seem to be the target after all...
rows.display_text:
「H-Hap... that guy didn't seem to be the
target after all...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Looks like that was a fake. Seems the client was testing us.
rows.display_text:
「Looks like that was a fake. Seems the
client was testing us.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Testing us...?
rows.display_text: 「Testing us...?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: It means the goods you're carrying are worth that much. Don't you forget it.
rows.display_text:
「It means the goods you're carrying are
worth that much. Don't you forget it.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Y-yes, sir...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yes, sir...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Hm... instructions just came in from the client. Wh-what...!?
rows.display_text:
「Hm... instructions just came in from the
client. Wh-what...!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: What's wrong?
rows.display_text: 「What's wrong?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: What a cautious character... The client's put up a proxy, and wants you to hand the goods to that person instead.
rows.display_text:
「What a cautious character... The
client's put up a proxy, and wants you to
hand the goods to that person instead.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: The distinguishing features of that person are...
rows.display_text:
「The distinguishing features of that
person are...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Y-yes...?

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: And the password is...
rows.display_text: 「And the password is...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: You want me to say that!?
rows.display_text: 「You want me to say that!?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Those are their instructions. ...But don't worry. We told them your features too.
rows.display_text:
「Those are their instructions. ...But
don't worry. We told them your features
too.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: We let them know a boy in a helmet and tracksuit with a drooping mustache, and a sharp-looking girl in glasses, would be coming.
rows.display_text:
「We told them a boy in a helmet and
tracksuit with a droopy mustache, and a
sharp girl in glasses, were coming.」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Well then, good luck.
rows.display_text: 「Well then, good luck.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Miss Gainer... we've got no choice but to steel ourselves.
rows.display_text:
「Miss Gainer... we've got no choice but
to steel ourselves.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: But, Renton... this errand...
rows.display_text: 「But, Renton... this errand...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'm... going to do it.
rows.display_text: 「I'm... going to do it.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: When I pull this mission off, I think I'll finally become a real member of Gekkostate.
rows.display_text:
「When I pull this mission off, I think
I'll finally become a real member of
Gekkostate.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Wait, Renton...! This errand is...
rows.display_text: 「Wait, Renton...! This errand is...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Miss Gainer...! I'm going! This is my fight!!
rows.display_text:
「Miss Gainer...! I'm going! This is my
fight!!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Are you an idiot!?
rows.display_text: 「Are you an idiot!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Brother Doggy!
rows.display_text: 「Brother Doggy!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Thank you!!
rows.display_text: 「Thank you!!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: You came again today! Because you were worried about me!
rows.display_text:
「You came again today! Because you were
worried about me!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I'm... really happy. Brother Doggy really is my big brother!
rows.display_text:
「I'm... really happy. Brother Doggy really
is my big brother!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: You... you actually know everything, don't you!?
rows.display_text:
「You... you actually know everything,
don't you!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: It was the same thing last time! You know exactly what position you're in, and you're doing this on purpose, aren't you!?
rows.display_text:
「It was the same thing last time! You
know exactly what position you're in, and
you're doing this on purpose, aren't you!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Eh... uh... I mean... I don't get what you--
rows.display_text:
「Eh... uh... I mean... I don't get what
you--」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Making a fool out of me! You... you--!!
rows.display_text: 「Making a fool out of me! You... you--!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...Brother Doggy, you really are a kind person, aren't you.
rows.display_text:
「...Brother Doggy, you really are a kind
person, aren't you.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Saying such harsh things on purpose, just to encourage me...
rows.display_text:
「Saying such harsh things on purpose,
just to encourage me...」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: H-hold on a second...!
rows.display_text: 「H-hold on a second...!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I was... scared. Scared that delivering these goods into someone's hands might end up hurting innocent people...
rows.display_text:
「I was... scared. Scared that delivering
these goods into someone's hands might
end up hurting innocent people...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But that's no good, is it!
rows.display_text: 「But that's no good, is it!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: H-hey...
rows.display_text: 「H-hey...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I was... such a kid!
rows.display_text: 「I was... such a kid!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: I decided this the moment I climbed aboard the Gekko-Goh!
rows.display_text:
「I decided this the moment I climbed
aboard the Gekko-Goh!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: That even if I had to turn the whole world into my enemy, I'd be there for Eureka!!
rows.display_text:
「That even if I had to turn the whole
world into my enemy, I'd be there for
Eureka!!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Renton...
rows.display_text: 「Renton...」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Y-you...
rows.display_text: 「Y-you...」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Could it be... you're actually amazing, after all...
rows.display_text:
「Could it be... you're actually amazing,
after all...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Thanks to you, I've finally made up my mind. Real kindness hidden inside toughness... Thank you! Brother Doggy!!
rows.display_text:
「Thanks to you, I've finally made up my
mind. Real kindness hidden inside
toughness... Thank you! Brother Doggy!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You've been loud as hell this whole time, kid!
rows.display_text:
「You've been loud as hell this whole
time, kid!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: You're...!
rows.display_text: 「You're...!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Wh-what is it...!
rows.display_text: 「Wh-what is it...!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: That ridiculously jutting chin...! You must be the one who's supposed to receive the goods!
rows.display_text:
「That ridiculously jutting chin...! You
must be the one who's supposed to
receive the goods!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You bastard! Bringing up something a guy's sensitive about...
rows.display_text:
「You bastard! Bringing up something a
guy's sensitive about...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Um... let's see... the password is...
rows.display_text: 「Um... let's see... the password is...」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: You've got a bread roll stuck on your chin!
rows.display_text:
「You've got a bread roll stuck on your
chin!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: You bastard!! You looking to die!!
rows.display_text: 「You bastard!! You looking to die!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Hey, what are you doing! Don't start trouble in a place like this!
rows.display_text:
「Hey, what are you doing! Don't start
trouble in a place like this!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: B-but...! This kid seems to know my face...
rows.display_text:
「B-but...! This kid seems to know my
face...」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: Tch! So a bounty hunter's tracked me down even out here!!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! So a bounty hunter's tracked me
down even out here!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: This brat's got some nerve! I'll turn the tables on him!!
rows.display_text:
「This brat's got some nerve! I'll turn
the tables on him!!」

rows.speaker: Breaker
rows.en: I'm bringing out the Walker Machine! If it's come to this, I'll take it all the way!
rows.display_text:
「I'm bringing out the Walker Machine! If
it's come to this, I'll take it all the
way!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Uh... um... I'm... from Gekkostate...
rows.display_text: 「Uh... um... I'm... from Gekkostate...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Run, Renton! These guys are serious!
rows.display_text: 「Run, Renton! These guys are serious!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Why! Why does it always turn out like this!!
rows.display_text:
「Why! Why does it always turn out like
this!!」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: ...Sounds like you had a rough time, Renton.
rows.display_text:
「...Sounds like you had a rough time,
Renton.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: We're the ones who had it rough! I don't even want to remember Ken-Goh's lecture afterward!
rows.display_text:
「We're the ones who had it rough! I
don't even want to remember Ken-Goh's
lecture afterward!」

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: That's what you call bringing it on yourself.
rows.display_text:
「That's what you call bringing it on
yourself.」

rows.speaker: Stoner
rows.en: That time, Renton's natural cluelessness had us laughing, and then Gainer's got us good.
rows.display_text:
「That time, Renton's natural cluelessness
had us laughing, and then Gainer's got us
good.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Y-yeah... well...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah... well...」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Just come clean, Gainer. It was all calculated from the start, wasn't it?
rows.display_text:
「Just come clean, Gainer. It was all
calculated from the start, wasn't it?」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: What!?
rows.display_text: 「What!?」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Then you...! You already knew it was a prank back then!?
rows.display_text:
「Then you...! You already knew it was a
prank back then!?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Well, part of it was that the instructions were just way too outrageous...
rows.display_text:
「Well, part of it was that the
instructions were just way too
outrageous...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Back then, Hap, you said 'a girl in glasses,' didn't you?
rows.display_text:
「Back then, Hap, you said 'a girl in
glasses,' didn't you?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Did I say that...?
rows.display_text: 「Did I say that...?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: There's no way you'd know about my cross-dressing unless you could see our situation...
rows.display_text:
「There's no way you'd know about my
cross-dressing unless you could see our
situation...」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: That's how I realized we were being watched and made a laughingstock of.
rows.display_text:
「That's how I realized we were being
watched and made a laughingstock of.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Well, look at that. So he played dumb and then spilled the whole thing to Ken-Goh.
rows.display_text:
「Well, look at that. So he played dumb
and then spilled the whole thing to
Ken-Goh.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Gainer! You little...!!
rows.display_text: 「Gainer! You little...!!」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: This guy...! Pulling such a sneaky move!
rows.display_text: 「This guy...! Pulling such a sneaky move!」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: What are you talking about. You're the ones who tried to trick us first.
rows.display_text:
「What are you talking about. You're the
ones who tried to trick us first.」

rows.speaker: Ana
rows.en: Gainer's right. Grown adults ganging up to bully a child -- you should be ashamed of yourselves.
rows.display_text:
「Gainer's right. Grown adults ganging up
to bully a child -- you should be ashamed
of yourselves.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: But still, back then, I'll be honest -- I was jealous of Renton's guts.
rows.display_text:
「But still, back then, I'll be honest --
I was jealous of Renton's guts.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Brother Doggy...
rows.display_text: 「Brother Doggy...」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Your reckless drive back then was something else. From that moment, you became my rival.
rows.display_text:
「Your reckless drive back then was
something else. From that moment, you
became my rival.」

rows.speaker: Gidget
rows.en: Before Renton showed up, Doggy was the one everyone picked on, after all.
rows.display_text:
「Before Renton showed up, Doggy was
the one everyone picked on, after all.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: But when I was getting picked on, I still thought of myself as one of the gang. So, you being the new guy, you were an eyesore to me.
rows.display_text:
「But even while getting picked on, I
still felt like one of the gang. So you,
the new guy, were an eyesore to me.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: But that fight of yours, where you put your whole body on the line... it hit me hard...
rows.display_text:
「But that fight of yours, where you put
your whole body on the line... it hit me
hard...」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: So I worked hard too. Trying not to lose to your guts.
rows.display_text:
「So I worked hard too. Trying not to
lose to your guts.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Brother Doggy! You really are my big brother!
rows.display_text:
「Brother Doggy! You really are my big
brother!」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Let's do our best, Renton. We'll definitely save Eureka.
rows.display_text:
「Let's do our best, Renton. We'll
definitely save Eureka.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Right!
rows.display_text: 「Right!」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: Good spirit, Renton. You're every bit the grandson of Axel Thurston.
rows.display_text:
「Good spirit, Renton. You're every bit
the grandson of Axel Thurston.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: You knew my grandpa?
rows.display_text: 「You knew my grandpa?」

rows.speaker: Roger
rows.en: That man did a great deal for me too.
rows.display_text: 「That man did a great deal for me too.」

rows.speaker: Banjo
rows.en: Well then, next let's talk about the incident the Negotiator and I ran into at Bellforest.
rows.display_text:
「Well then, next let's talk about the
incident the Negotiator and I ran into at
Bellforest.」
